description: This Java source file defines an immutable data transfer object (DTO) class CenterData representing group centers in the system. It includes various properties such as identifiers, status, associated members, calendar data, and financial totals, along with several factory methods for creating instances with specific configurations.

methods.description: Creates a new CenterData instance by combining a template and an existing CenterData instance.
